echoesIntegration.title: ECHOES integration
echoesIntegration.intro: Inspect how this VTL transcription is represented through the ECHOES Common Platform: resolve its HDT, register or snapshot VTL resources, verify semantic links and inspect managed operations.
echoesIntegration.missingApi: Common Platform API URL is not configured (commonPlatformApi).
echoesIntegration.referenceModeHint: Register only the provider-owned URL. VTL keeps ownership of the bytes while ECHOES assigns a stable Asset identity.
echoesIntegration.snapshotModeHint: Read the current hOCR bytes from VTL, upload them through the Common Platform upload capability, finalise the MANAGED Asset and enrich the HDT.
echoesIntegration.snapshotUnavailable: Snapshot mode is enabled only for resources that VTL can read directly in this PoC.
echoesIntegration.snapshotDisabled: Managed snapshot upload is disabled by deployment configuration (commonPlatformManagedUploadEnabled).
echoesIntegration.platformStateSection: 3. Semantic state visible through Common Platform
echoesIntegration.platformStateHint: The check executes Platform Semantic Query V1 for HDTO HP29 and resolves returned canonical Asset URIs back through GET /assets/{assetId}. No FORTH repository or graph identifier is exposed to VTL.
echoesIntegration.noSemanticAssets: No HP29 digital-object parts are visible for the selected HDT in the configured Semantic Query target.
echoesIntegration.operationsHint: Caller-owned Common Platform operations. The currently running operation is shown separately while VTL polls its platform resource.
